_: Luong 'xem tong hop tien do lop roi mo ho so chi tiet mot hoc vien' cua actor A2, hien thuc hoa usecase_gv_theo_doi_tien_do_lop (F1-28 + F1-27). _ma_truc_tiep: F1-28 la ma TRUC TIEP cho ca dashboard, khong con la 'dan xuat tu F1-06/F1-07' nhu bang slug o system_survey.md:524 con ghi -- class_progress.md muc 2 da sua dong nay.
_khong_ve: KHONG ve dashboard tong quan khoi luong cong viec (F1-30, man instructor_overview): hinh dang tuan tu cua no gan nhu trung voi buoc 1-6 o day (mo man -> may chu tong hop -> tra ve), ve them chi lap lai. F1-27 gioi han PHAM VI theo lop phu trach (tu choi neu khong phu trach lop do, US-A2-08) -- do la kiem quyen, khong ve thanh nhanh alt.
_granularity: 03-dd/api/ hien rong nen ba tang gom thanh 'May chu AlgoPrep'; cac nguong phan loai 'Can chu y' la [SoT: Suy luan] o chinh RD (class_progress.md ghi cac con so nguong se tinh chinh o BD/DD), nen so do chi ve viec DOC du lieu de xac dinh, khong ve cong thuc.
